executable_actions.on_failure: Keep VCS-derived functional claims and all hardware repairs blocked. Do not attribute the termination to VCD, JSONL, report code, AXI, loader, or RTL without the required causal context; retain the capability gap and SACG retry/barrier state.

executable_actions.rationale: The supplied repair execution feedback establishes a missing capability: the runner/analyzer cannot distinguish simulator infrastructure termination from deterministic HDL/testbench termination for a pre-terminal SIGSEGV. Implement external replay provenance capture before any source-level diagnosis; its implementation must preserve immutable source identity, target-model comparison inputs, numeric policy, and checker schemas.

executable_actions.on_failure: If provenance classifies simulator/runner infrastructure termination, return to repair.approve_and_implement_remote_vcs_termination_provenance without a source patch. If it identifies a deterministic current-layer failure, invoke repair.localize_current_board_boundary_before_any_patch. Do not promote, loosen comparison policy, derive expected values from RTL, or reopen lower layers.
executable_actions.rationale: Once identity authority is accepted and termination provenance is available, execute the required current-layer boundary replay using the exact board wrapper and immutable semantic comparison contract. The replay must produce either a valid terminal semantic result or enough causal context to classify an abnormal termination; neither outcome is inferred from static reports.

observations: The direct executed failure is real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface: the board-simulation source identity, Vivado-export compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and simulator executable authorization do not bind the current discovered exact sample-project identity.

functional_sim=fail is dependency closure only because case_vcs_functional_sim was not run after case_axi_ddr_interface failed. It is not evidence of a board value, numeric, ordering, AXI, DDR, liveness, weight-consumption, output-frontier, or RTL failure.

The prior hash-bound VCS attempt that compiled and then ended in SIGSEGV is reusable only as rejected diagnostic history. Its stack did not identify an active HDL process/event or source location, so it neither identifies a board RTL root cause nor contradicts a certified lower-layer invariant.

Live lower-layer knowledge remains reusable: operator-leaf and connected single-layer certificates are hash validated. The connected kernel is certified as an elastic variable-latency token pipeline with preserved boundary order and required cross-token overlap; unequal same-cycle stage timing is not a failure. No current trace provides core start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and certificate contradiction evidence required to reopen it.
The missing board semantic-evidence report and other not_run reports are consequences of the static gate/dependency blockage, not independently repairable report-schema defects.

sacg_memory_truth has 15 active contamination barriers and six open retry requests, including current-scope retry_request.0143 and retry_request.0144. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts may guide this repair but are not validated inputs or promotion evidence; the open requests require bounded repair followed by a fresh Stage7 rerun.
The conditional design-team route was no_split. It adds no specialist action and cannot substitute for the required exact-board tool evidence.
proposed_actions: Create a candidate exact-board identity and canonical VCS authority binding from the already discovered sample-project wrapper and actual Vivado export facts, without modifying DUT RTL, wrapper sources, semantic testbench semantics, golden outputs, or numeric policy; rerun case_axi_ddr_interface.

Obtain bounded approval to implement the missing external remote-VCS termination-provenance capability, then use it on a fresh exact-source replay rather than changing read-only VCD, JSONL, or report logic.

After the static identity gate passes, run the current board VCS replay and evidence analyzer against immutable target-model semantic inputs. Classify any nonterminal or SIGSEGV result before proposing a hardware repair.
For a deterministic dynamic failure only, localize and targeted-replay the current board boundary. Keep lower certificates closed unless the trace explicitly contradicts a named certified invariant.

If functional simulation passes, execute the remaining board-level verification DAG and semantic-evidence assembly in dependency order; otherwise return the actual tool result to bounded repair and retain the SACG barriers/retry requests.
risks: Rebinding an identity document or compile plan to stale, inferred, or simplified wrapper facts would invalidate board integration even if model, shape, numeric, data-order, memory, runtime, and kernel evidence remain correct.

A loader/harness repair that changes checkpoint scope, tensor hashes, target-model reference, stimulus, numeric tolerances, semantic-testbench behavior, or DUT weight-consumption requirements would contaminate comparison evidence and is prohibited.
Without external termination provenance, another VCS SIGSEGV could be misclassified as an HDL, VCD/JSON/report, AXI, or kernel defect; speculative edits to those sources could conceal the failure.
Independent AXI or prefetch activity and stage-0 ingress are not output/lifecycle-frontier progress and cannot justify a pass or a lower-layer backtrack.

The board layer remains blocked from Vivado synthesis/implementation, bitstream generation, runtime ABI release, and board runtime until the complete current-layer gate DAG passes with real-tool semantic evidence.

artifacts: verification/board_interface/discovered exact sample-project identity and Vivado-export facts
constraints: Use the exact user-supplied board wrapper, simulation sources, discovered source hashes, and Vivado-export facts; do not substitute or guess a wrapper, executable, top, path, or target.

Keep checkpoint, deterministic/real stimulus provenance, target-model reference outputs, complete Transformer-block tensor catalog, numeric policy/tolerances, semantic-testbench contract and hashes immutable; expected values must remain target-model inference outputs.
Require complete-scope bound-weight consumption proof before any functional pass; Transformer blocks only are in DUT scope.
Do not reopen certified leaf or connected-kernel scopes without a current hash-bound trace that directly contradicts a named certificate invariant.
Treat all 15 active contamination barriers and all 6 open retry requests in sacg_memory_truth as active downstream-trust blockers until a successful current Stage7 reassessment.

No RTL, lower-layer, numeric-policy, checkpoint, stimulus, golden, or board-wrapper source change is authorized from the present evidence; backend and board promotion remain blocked.
